title: QF-02 internal shadow admission protocol
exposure: Fleet internal service only; no public Gateway management proxy
authentication: Independent ANSTS_ADMISSION_SERVICE_TOKEN; actor comes from trusted coordinator, not browser claims

operations.response: Up to 100 pending/in-flight/quarantined messages in authorized historical region; default limit 25
One leased shadow message delivered to an independent durable mailbox; recording acknowledgement never changes execution or quota state
Current persisted controller configuration/runtime and native alarmAt; null delivery means not initialized
Immutable configuration receipt and current configuration/runtime; replay never overwrites a later pause
Authenticated Host observation applied idempotently; sourceVerified=true does not authorize execution or provide price/cost evidence

expiresAt.description: Server-checked epoch milliseconds, after now and within five minutes

executionInputDigest.description: Optional pinned task input. Required for authenticated Body observations; legacy unpinned reservations cannot consume evidence.

notes: Each execution reservation requires concurrentAttempts=1 and queuedTasks=0. Queue admission is not integrated.
Tokens authenticate exact canonical claims and target; verification also requires current authoritative reservation state. Offline signature alone cannot prove revocation.
The shadow credential is not a Body execution grant and is never sent to Engine.
Capacity receipts are unverified shadow adapter inputs. Runtime and settlement transitions stay closed until authenticated adapters exist.
There is no fee snapshot, trusted provider-cost bound, usage ledger, trusted runtime compensation, or real enforcement yet.
Outbox intent, reservation, audit and idempotency receipt commit atomically. Events have stable IDs; replay never recreates acknowledged events.
Dispatch uses a 10-second durable lease, a 3-second transport deadline, and 1-to-60-second retry backoff. No pending message, deduplication receipt, or revocation tombstone is TTL-deleted.
Receiver records shadow observations and generation/version tombstones only. Same event ID with changed content is quarantined; duplicate identical input returns the immutable original receipt.
Claiming recovers legacy states by deterministic event IDs. Expired acquisition intents and acquisition for disabled tenants are quarantined without releasing occupancy.
A new admission mutation initializes RUNNING automatic shadow delivery after native alarm registration. Legacy records require explicit enable; PAUSED remains paused on later mutations.
RUNNING keeps a 60-second durable heartbeat, including idle queues. Due work is processed in batches of at most four, with a persisted watchdog registered before network I/O.
Directory/controller failures reschedule with a 30-second floor; transport retries retain their existing bounded backoff. No callback failure clears occupancy.

Pause controls automatic message delivery only; an already claimed message may finish and explicit authorized dispatch remains available. It does not stop Engine or enable/disable real admission enforcement.
New pinned-input reservations use an unpredictable server challenge in requestDigest; evidence cannot be prepared before reservation creation.
admission-observe-execution validates Host HMAC facts against pinned identity/input/resources. RUNNING/NOT_STARTED/TERMINATED raw transition requests remain closed.
Verified termination moves to SETTLING, frees resource quota and retains unpriced budget. BodyAgent automatic context/evidence delivery and real execution admission are not connected yet.
